AnnexuriA
Sulieman Ravell owns 10096 of 54 Super Pty Ltd ACN 632 004 481 ATF 54 Super Fund
(54).
Sulleman Ravell has a relevant Interest In 310,441 fully paid ordinary shares held by S4
dlrectlyln Keybrldge Capital Limited (K=ybrldp), comprising approximately 0.1% of the
share capital of Keybridge.
On 27 November 2024 Carter close of business hours) Mr Ravell consented to be
nominated byWAM Active as a proposed director of Keybridge Capital Limited. This
consent might be taken to give rise to a technical association with WAM Active Limited.
Foran abundance of caution, Itwas considered appropriate to lodge this form.
WAM Active Limited (WAM) has declared its and its associates' relevant Interest In
94,612,457 fully paid ordinary shares In Keybridge, pursuantto an ASIC Form 604
lodged byWAM on 25 August 2021, a copy ofwhich Is attached at Annexure C ofthis
notice.
The relevant Interest percentages disclosed In this notice are based on 207,337,836
issued shares
